name: plugin.opencode_bridge
description: OpenCode Bridge plugin providing CLI status, headless prompt execution, session inspection, and tool cataloging
author: Brain Harness Authors

entrypoints.name: opencode_status
entrypoints.description: Inspect OpenCode CLI availability, version, background server daemon status, and active port.

entrypoints.name: opencode_run_prompt
entrypoints.description: Execute a headless non-interactive instruction through OpenCode CLI with working directory isolation.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Instruction or prompt to execute in OpenCode.

parameters.name: auto_approve
parameters.description: Automatically approve tool operations not explicitly denied.

entrypoints.name: opencode_session_info
entrypoints.description: Enumerate active/past OpenCode sessions or inspect session status.

entrypoints.name: opencode_tool_catalog
entrypoints.description: List built-in OpenCode tools (edit, patch, persistent-pty, codemode) and active MCP servers.
